jobs.description:
Who We Are
We are a well-funded, early-stage technology company on a mission to fundamentally redefine the way the world searches, discovers, and transacts, built on a philosophy that puts the user first at every step.
The user is not simply a means of transaction. They are a valued participant whose data works for them, not against them, enriching their world and their own experience within it, with them retaining full control.
Our mission is underpinned by proprietary, patent-pending technology built on a novel engine and system.

The Problem You Will Be Solving
The internet was built to inform the many, not to serve the individual. Platforms optimize for engagement, extraction, and consumption at global scale. AI has made this model even more efficient, with the user still largely remaining the input, not the full beneficiary.
The problem is not information. The world has never had more. The problem is that people give away a lifetime of data without receiving the personalized experience it should enable. 
People should not have to search. They should simply find.

Who You Are
• Highly talented and motivated to build products with people, for people
• You thrive in zero-to-one environments and find genuine satisfaction in creating from scratch
• A fast-paced thinker with a relentless desire to learn, improve, and raise the standard around you
• Able to inspire, elevate, and collaborate; you make the people around you better
• A great communicator; you express complex ideas with clarity, precision, and confidence across all levels of the organization
• Able to transform ideas into working systems and technical milestones with light speed and precision
• Highly ambitious and action-driven; you thrive under pressure and find genuine energy in working at the edge of what is considered possible

What You Will Do
• Design and build multi-agent pipelines and AI systems that decompose complex operational tasks into sequences of discrete actions across multiple downstream services
• Build LLM orchestration frameworks that govern agentic execution including prompt construction, tool selection, output validation, context management, and structured logging
• Build tool-use and function-calling infrastructure that connects AI reasoning to real-world APIs, external services, and operational systems
• Design task understanding and decomposition systems that translate inputs into executable plans with appropriate confidence bounds
• Build reliability and recovery layers that ensure safe agentic execution through graceful degradation paths, error recovery, and human escalation triggers
• Build evaluation infrastructure for agentic systems that measures task completion, failure mode distribution, and system reliability across multi-step execution chains

Minimum Qualifications
• Demonstrated experience building agentic AI systems that operate reliably in production; the distinction between this and a working demonstration is the primary thing we assess
• Deep working knowledge of LLM orchestration; including a clear understanding of where current frameworks succeed and where they introduce reliability risks in production conditions
• First-principles understanding of agentic failure modes; hallucination at tool boundaries, context degradation across long chains, non-determinism in consequential actions, and demonstrated practice of building defensively against each
• Fast, disciplined engineering in a domain that changes rapidly
• Candidates with exceptional research backgrounds in LLM reliability, AI planning, or multi-agent systems will be considered alongside those with direct production experience

Preferred Qualifications
• MSc or PhD in Computer Science or Artificial Intelligence from KTH, Chalmers, or an institution of equivalent standing; PhD candidates working on LLM reliability, planning, or multi-agent coordination are actively sought
• Open source contributions or published work in agentic AI, LLM reliability, or related areas
• Demonstrated ability to ship production-grade agentic systems faster than peers would consider realistic
• 2–5 years of experience; demonstrated capability outweighs tenure in a field this new

What We Offer
Expect the most talented, rigorous, and driven colleagues you have worked with; people who lift each other up and hold each other to the highest standard. This company is driven by ideas and innovation, regardless of age, position, or background. The best ideas must win and the people behind them recognized and rewarded.
A home for exceptional people and geniuses within their domain; those who have always known what they are capable of and have been waiting for the environment to prove it to the world, whilst first being seen and supported by their coworkers.
Compensation includes an attractive salary and meaningful equity ownership for an early-stage startup.

Equal Opportunity
We are an equal opportunity employer committed to building an inclusive, high-performance culture where everyone can do their best work and reach their full potential. We welcome applicants of all backgrounds and do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, national origin, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, disability, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law.

Application
To apply, send your CV/resume, LinkedIn profile, and a brief note on how and why you would like to contribute to our mission. Upon initial acceptance, an online interview will follow shortly.
Please note that all applications and interviews are conducted in English. Fluency in written and spoken English is a requirement for all roles.
All applications are treated with strict confidentiality.

jobs.occupation: Souschef till vårt växtbaserade produktionskök i Stockholm
jobs.description:
Rebelly lagar tredagarsfastor som folk faktiskt längtar efter att äta. Allt tillagas från grunden i vårt eget produktionskök i Stockholm och levereras till kunder i hela Sverige. Menyn byts varje månad, vi tar fram nya produkter och vi jobbar med de bästa råvarorna vi kan hitta. Allt är alltid veganskt och glutenfritt, eftersom fastan följer en metod som bygger på forskning om fasta. Det är ramarna, och inom dem finns kreativiteten.
Nu söker vi en souschef som blir nummer två till vår kökschef.

OM ROLLEN
Du jobbar sida vid sida med kökschefen och driver köket när han inte är där. Du planerar och leder produktionsdagarna: ugnar, blästerkylar, preplistor och vem som gör vad. Du bygger recept och skalar dem från provsats till över 300 portioner utan att smaken ändras. Du håller egenkontrollen och HACCP i ordning varje vecka, och du bygger rutiner, listor och dokumentation som håller när vi växer.
Vi har ingen servering och ingen pass. Köket går i dag måndag till fredag, 08–16. När vi växer kan det bli fler skift.

VEM VI SÖKER
Det vi söker mest är ordning. Du är riktigt kunnig i köket, extremt ordningsam och jobbar kliniskt rent. Du vill jobba hårt och köra, du tar ansvar utan att någon behöver be dig, och du letar efter något långsiktigt.

Du har:
- erfarenhet som souschef, köksmästare eller i en annan ledande roll i kök
- kunskap om HACCP och egenkontroll i praktiken
- vana att bygga och skala recept, gärna från storkök, catering eller produktion
- god engelska (svenska är meriterande)
Meriterande: växtbaserad matlagning och storköksmetoder som GN-bleck, kombiugnar och blästerkyl.

VI ERBJUDER
En nyckelroll i ett bolag som växer snabbt. Planen är att Rebelly om några år finns på fler platser än Stockholm, och kökschefens nummer två är den som ligger närmast att driva köket på en ny plats när vi öppnar. Du blir en del av ett litet team där alla har samma mål: att bygga Rebelly.
Heltid, tillsvidare med sex månaders provanställning.
Lön: 30 000–35 000 kr i månaden beroende på erfarenhet.

SÅ SÖKER DU
Mejla ditt CV till join@rebelly.se och skriv "Souschef" i ämnesraden. Skriv i mejlet när du kan börja och ge ett kort exempel på en rutin eller ett system du har byggt i ett kök. Vi går igenom ansökningarna löpande och bjuder in till ett betalt provpass i köket, så vänta inte med att söka.
---
IN ENGLISH
Rebelly cooks three-day fasts that people actually look forward to eating. Everything is made from scratch in our own production kitchen in Stockholm and delivered to customers all over Sweden. The menu changes every month, we develop new products, and we work with the best raw ingredients we can find. Everything is always vegan and gluten-free, because the fast follows a method built on research on fasting. Those are the edges, and the creativity lives inside them.
We are now looking for a sous chef to become number two to our Head of Kitchen.

THE ROLE
You work side by side with the Head of Kitchen and run the kitchen when he is not there. You plan and lead the production days: ovens, blast chillers, prep lists, who does what and when. You build recipes and scale them from a test batch to more than 300 portions without the taste changing. You keep self-monitoring and HACCP in order every week, and you build routines, lists and records that hold as we grow.
There is no service and no pass. Today the kitchen runs Monday to Friday, 08:00 to 16:00. As we grow, there may be more shifts.

WHO WE ARE LOOKING FOR
What we need most is order. You are highly skilled in the kitchen, extremely orderly and you work clinically clean. You want to work hard and drive things forward, you take responsibility without being asked, and you are looking for something long-term.

You have:
- experience as a sous chef, head chef or in another leading kitchen role
- hands-on knowledge of HACCP and self-monitoring
- experience building and scaling recipes, ideally from large-scale kitchens, catering or production
- good English (Swedish is a plus)
A plus: plant-based cooking and large-scale methods such as gastronorm trays, combi ovens and blast chillers.

WHAT WE OFFER
A key role in a company that is growing fast. The plan is that Rebelly will be in more places than Stockholm within a few years, and the Head of Kitchen's number two is the natural person to run the kitchen in a new location when we open one. You join a small team where everyone shares one goal: to build Rebelly.
Full time, permanent with a six-month probation period.
Salary: 30,000–35,000 SEK per month depending on experience.

HOW TO APPLY
Email your CV to join@rebelly.se with "Sous Chef" in the subject line. Tell us when you can start, and give a short example of a routine or system you have built in a kitchen. We review applications continuously and invite candidates to a paid trial shift in the kitchen, so do not wait to apply.

Are you passionate about automotive technology, advanced driver assistance systems, and testing vehicles in real-world driving conditions? This is an exciting opportunity to contribute to the verification and validation of intelligent vehicle functions that improve safety, driving experience, and customer confidence.
We’re looking for a hands-on engineer who enjoys working close to the vehicle, analysing technical behaviour, and translating test findings into actionable improvements for development teams.
📍 Location: Gothenburg, Sweden
🏢 Work model: 100% on-site – no remote work
📅 Assignment period: 26 October 2026 – 31 August 2028
🎯 Seniority: Intermediate
🗣️ Working language: English
🎯 About the Role
You will work with the verification and validation of advanced driver assistance systems (ADAS) and vehicle functions, with a strong focus on physical in-vehicle testing and customer-relevant driving scenarios.
You will plan, prepare, execute, and document tests using complete vehicles, proving grounds, and public roads. Where appropriate, you will complement physical testing with rig-based or simulation environments.
Your work will help ensure that vehicle functions are safe, reliable, robust, intuitive, and suitable for everyday driving.

Plan, prepare, execute, and document in-vehicle tests for ADAS and advanced vehicle functions.
Validate functional behaviour and performance in real-world driving situations and customer-relevant scenarios.
Prepare test vehicles, test objects, test setups, and driving routes.
Conduct structured testing on public roads and proving grounds.
Define test scenarios, acceptance criteria, pass/fail criteria, and verification methods.
Evaluate function robustness, availability, usability, comfort, and overall driving experience.
Analyze vehicle logs and test results to identify deviations, investigate issues, and support root-cause analysis.
Provide clear, structured feedback to software developers, function owners, system engineers, and other development stakeholders.
Work with in-vehicle communication, diagnostics, and data-logging tools.
Contribute to continuous improvement of test methods, test coverage, and testing efficiency.
Collaborate with test leads, fleet coordinators, suppliers, and cross-functional engineering teams.
Use simulation, HIL/SIL, rig testing, or automated verification where appropriate to complement vehicle testing.

✅ Required Skills & Qualifications
Bachelor's or Master's degree in Mechatronics, Electrical Engineering, Automation and Control, Automotive Engineering, Computer Science, or equivalent relevant experience.
Hands-on experience with complete vehicle testing, preferably within ADAS, active safety, automated driving, or other customer-facing vehicle functions.
Experience planning, executing, and documenting physical vehicle tests.
Understanding of verification and validation methods, test scenarios, acceptance criteria, and deviation handling.
Ability to assess vehicle functionality from both technical and customer perspectives.
Experience analysing vehicle logs and test results to support troubleshooting and root-cause analysis.
Knowledge of in-vehicle communication, diagnostics, and data logging.
Familiarity with automotive test tools such as CANoe, CANalyzer, CANape, INCA, DLT, or equivalent tools.
Valid Swedish B driving licence and confidence conducting structured tests in real vehicles.
Proficiency in English, both written and spoken.
Strong analytical, documentation, communication, and problem-solving skills.

⭐ Nice-to-Have Skills
Basic scripting or automation skills, particularly Python, for log analysis and test preparation.
Experience with HIL, SIL, test rigs, simulation, or CI/CD-based verification.
Experience with ADAS, active safety, collision avoidance, or automated driving systems.
Additional driver training or experience as a safety driver.
Proving-ground testing experience.
Experience with customer-oriented vehicle testing or fleet operations.

👤 Our Ideal Candidate
You are a self-driven, structured, and practical engineer with a genuine interest in vehicles and advanced automotive technology.
You enjoy investigating how vehicle functions behave in real driving conditions and understand the difference between a feature that technically works and one that feels safe, reliable, and intuitive to the driver.
You communicate clearly, take ownership of your findings, and work collaboratively to transform observations into meaningful engineering improvements. You are comfortable moving between hands-on vehicle testing, technical analysis, and discussions with cross-functional development teams.

jobs.description:
Department of Biosystems and Technology
 
PhD project in Agricultural Science: Using agricultural crop biomass for biogas in synergy with the development of sustainable cropping systems
 
Note: This advertisement is abbreviated to fit in Platsbanken's recruitment tool. To view the ad in its entirety including additional information, please visit https://www.slu.se/en/about-slu/work-at-slu/jobs-and-vacancies/
 
About the position
Targeting the sustainable supply of agricultural crop biomass as substrates for biogas, the project will use a field experiment platform to investigate crop yields and crop nutrient dynamics in different scenarios for biomass removal and nutrient redistribution via digestates. The research will primarily be based on an ongoing long-term cropping systems experiment with four distinct systems: conventional, organic, agroforestry and perennial cereal.
The biomass resources to be studied include, but are not limited to: cover crops, ley, straw (from cereals, grain legumes and oilseed crops), beet leaves, and possibly wood. Studies on quantities and nutrient contents of different biomasses build on existing data from the experiment, to be complemented with additional sample collection and analyses as well as literature data or data from agricultural statistics databases.
 
The holder of this position will be a part of a national transdisciplinary center of excellence called Biogas Solutions Research Center (BSRC). Here, co-production of new and relevant knowledge is generated through collaboration between different scientific disciplines as well as between researchers and practitioners from industry and public organizations. The BSRC includes researchers and support from two universities, Linköping University and Swedish University of Agricultural Sciences, as well as about 50 private and public organizations involving all parts of the biogas system. It also has support from the Swedish Energy Agency.
 
All doctoral positions advertised within BSRC will be formulated so that they fit into the competence center's research plans and at the same time reflect our parties' interests. This way, we ensure long-term competence supply to both industry and academia.

You should have a Master’s degree, or equivalent qualification, in a relevant field such as agricultural engineering (with specialization in crop production), agricultural science, agroecology, agronomy, biology, environmental science, horticultural science or another closely related discipline.
 
Your profile
We are looking for a highly motivated candidate with an interest in sustainable agriculture and bioeconomy systems, and in analysing complex interactions between biomass and food production and cropping system sustainability.
 
Experience or documented knowledge in one or several of the following areas is particularly relevant:
agricultural cropping systems, crop management and diversification;
systems analysis and/or multi-criteria sustainability assessments;
modelling or scenario analysis;
bioenergy systems based on agricultural crop biomass resources;
nutrient cycling e.g. via redistribution of biomass resources and biogas digestates;
crop and soil nutrient dynamics and nutrient balances at field and cropping system levels;
statistical analysis and handling of datasets with multiple experimental factors and response variables

Excellent written and spoken English is required. Good communication skills and an interest in communicating research both scientifically and to stakeholders are important. Knowledge of Swedish is advantageous but not a requirement.
 
Personal qualities, motivation for doctoral studies and the ability to successfully complete the research project will be given considerable weight in the selection process.

jobs.occupation: PhD Student in Landscape Governance and Management
jobs.description:
Department of Landscape Architecture, Planning and Management
Third-cycle subject area:
Landscape architecture
Description of the doctoral project:
Governance and organisational alignment related to the operation and maintenance (O&M) of urban drainage infrastructures
Stormwater transports a wide range of pollutants from urban environments to receiving waters, posing major challenges for the protection of surface waters and coastal ecosystems. Urban drainage infrastructures, such as gully pots and stormwater ponds, play a critical role by retaining sediments and associated contaminants. However, their performance depends on effective operation and maintenance (O&M), which in practice is often reactive or based on fixed schedules, despite large spatial and temporal variability in sediment accumulation and vegetation development. This PhD project is part of a larger interdisciplinary research initiative aiming to enable a transition towards more data-driven and environmentally responsible maintenance of urban drainage infrastructures. The overall goal is to reduce pollutant loads to coastal and marine environments while supporting sustainable urban water management.
The PhD research will focus on identifying strategies for coherent long-term organisational set-ups and assess how stakeholder discourses, rules and resources shape the feasibility of different O&M schemes defined within the overall project. This includes assessment of governance feasibility of the various O&M schemes, and identification of alignment strategies, drawing on legal and policy frameworks and economic frameworks identified by partners in the overall project. The programmatic alignment theory, long-term strategic management, and elements of Nature-based Thinking (the organisational, ecological and social interdependencies) will be applied as basis for the analysis. Based on this, organisational and governance aspects of long-term urban drainage infrastructure maintenance will be described, as well as governance challenges and barriers for achieving healthy coastal environments will be identified.
Within this project, the PhD student will be involved in collaboration with stakeholders in both the water and wastewater industry and the green sector. The PhD student will communicate results both with the industry and international researchers.
About the position:
As a PhD student, you will perform both empirical and theoretical work. You will learn how to collect and analyse data within your research area as well as communicate your results at national and international conferences and in scientific journals. Most of your working time will be devoted to your own research studies, including both research and coursework. In addition, you will also carry out departmental duties, such as teaching and/or assisting in other research projects. You will have two or three supervisors who support you in your work.
Requirements:
To meet the general entry requirements you must have:
been awarded a second-cycle (Master's) qualification;
satisfied the requirements for courses comprising at least 240 credits of which at least 60 credits were awarded in the second-cycle, or
acquired substantially equivalent knowledge in some other way in Sweden or abroad (Higher Education Ordinance 1993:100, Chapter 7, Section 39).

The special entry requirements for the subject landscape architecture are the equivalent of at least 90 higher education credits in courses relevant to landscape architecture. At least 30 credits must be at second-cycle level. For applicants who do not fulfil these criteria, eligibility is verified on a case-by-case basis taking into account the research task.
You must also meet the equivalent English language requirements as those necessary for the Swedish upper-secondary qualification Engelska B/6.
Your profile:
Required qualifications:
A Master's degree (or equivalent) in natural resources engineering, civil engineering, landscape architecture/management, organisational/governance theory or a related field
Excellent communication skills in English, both written and spoken
Ability to work independently and take initiative
Ability to engage with new research areas

Desirable qualifications:
Good communication skills in Swedish or another Scandinavian language, both written and spoken
A valid car driver's licence recognized in Sweden

About us:
The Landscape Governance and Management research group has a strong position in research and education on urban landscape governance and management, including urban water systems, primarily stormwater. The group consists of about 15 members and the group's overall goal is to contribute to how governance and management can be developed to support the sustainability, use and relevance of outdoor environments, often within applied development and in innovation-driven contexts.
